# Story 19.1: Red-phase unit tests for the single environment classifier

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase unit tests asserting one explicit environment classifier replaces `isDevEnvironment` and `isDevOrTest` with no broken-config placeholder fallbacks,
So that Story 19.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it consolidates the two divergent classifiers (P1 item #2 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A spec asserts that `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.ts` exposes exactly ONE environment classifier (not both `isDevEnvironment()` at lines ~146–150 and `isDevOrTest()` at lines ~230–234), and that all call sites use it.
2. A spec asserts the single classifier returns the correct environment for each representative `NODE_ENV` combination (dev, test, production, local).
3. A spec asserts no placeholder fallback (e.g., `process.env.DATABASE_URL` at lines ~216–219) yields a broken config — i.e., there is no code path that silently produces an unusable AWS/DB configuration from a missing env var.
4. All assertions in AC #1–#3 are marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) so the server Vitest suite runs green BEFORE Story 19.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. Existing passing tests remain unskipped and green.
5. The spec file(s) run green under `nx test server` immediately after this story (new red-phase tests skipped), and Story 19.2's first task is to remove the `.skip()` markers, confirm they FAIL against current code, then implement until they pass.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1): Add a single-classifier assertion.
  - [ ] 1.1 In `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.spec.ts` (or sibling), assert that only one environment classifier is exported/used and that both former call sites (`isDevEnvironment()` at line ~45, `isDevOrTest()` at line ~107) resolve to it.
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Add a per-NODE_ENV correctness assertion.
  - [ ] 2.1 Assert the single classifier returns the correct environment for each representative `NODE_ENV` value (`development`, `test`, `production`, `local`).
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3): Add a no-broken-config-fallback assertion.
  - [ ] 3.1 Assert that when `process.env.DATABASE_URL` is absent, the code does NOT silently fall back to an empty/broken config — it either throws or uses a clearly-named default.
- [ ] Task 4 (AC: #4, #5): Mark red-phase assertions `.skip()` and confirm green.
  - [ ] 4.1 Apply `it.skip` to every assertion added in Tasks 1–3 — they are red until Story 19.2 consolidates the classifiers. Leave all pre-existing tests unskipped.
  - [ ] 4.2 Run `nx test server` and confirm fully green with only the new red-phase tests skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.ts` currently exposes two divergent classifiers — `isDevEnvironment()` (lines ~146–150) and `isDevOrTest()` (lines ~230–234) — plus a placeholder fallback (`process.env.DATABASE_URL`, lines ~216–219) that can produce broken configs. Consolidating into one explicit classifier removes the divergence and reduces a security footgun (P1 item #2 from Aspect 9).
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 19.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while both classifiers still exist; Story 19.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then consolidates until green.
- **Do NOT modify production code in this story** — unit-test scaffold only. The consolidation belongs to Story 19.2.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; server tests run via `nx test server`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create/modify: `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.spec.ts` (or sibling) — add skipped single-classifier + per-NODE_ENV + no-broken-fallback assertions.
- No changes to production `.ts` in this story.
